title: Does a Pineapple Grow on a Tree?
description:
Does a Pineapple Grow on a Tree? Pineapple! Pineapples do not grow on trees! They grow on a spiky plant, close to the ground. Each pineapple grows for a long, long time. More than a whole year!
A quick fruits, vegetables and healthy habits Short for toddlers and preschoolers ages 2–6, with Pip the strawberry and Kiko the broccoli.

Pineapple! Pineapples do not grow on trees! They grow on a spiky plant, close to the ground. Each pineapple grows for a long, long time. More than a whole year! What are the spiky leaves on top called? The crown! Like a king or queen of fruits. Can you make spiky leaves on your head? Hands up, fingers out, like a pineapple crown!
